name: Firebase for Android & FCM
description: Provision Firebase Android apps, download their google-services.json configuration, manage signing certificates, and send Firebase Cloud Messaging HTTP v1 messages through one Google OAuth connection.

credential_fields.name: service_account_json
credential_fields.label: Legacy Firebase service account JSON
credential_fields.description: Execution-only compatibility field for existing service-account connections. New connections use Google OAuth.

credential_fields.name: relay_encryption_key
credential_fields.label: Relay encryption key
credential_fields.description: Generated automatically by Apteva for encrypting Firebase device identifiers at rest.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List Firebase projects accessible to the connected Google identity. Use nextPageToken with pageToken to continue. A project appearing here does not by itself prove that the identity can create apps or send messages; those operations also require the corresponding project IAM permissions.

pageSize.description: Maximum projects to return. Firebase may return fewer.

pageToken.description: Continuation token returned as nextPageToken by a previous call.

showDeleted.description: Include projects in the DELETED state.

tools.name: list_android_apps
tools.description: List Firebase Android apps in a project. Match the exact packageName before creating an app so provisioning remains idempotent. Continue with nextPageToken when present.

project_id.description: Firebase project ID or project number.

pageToken.description: Continuation token returned as nextPageToken by a previous call.

tools.name: create_android_app
tools.description: Request creation of a Firebase Android app. Returns a long-running Operation, not the final app. Poll get_operation using the ID after the operations/ prefix, then use the resulting appId with get_android_config. List apps first and reuse an exact packageName match.

project_id.description: Firebase project ID or project number.

packageName.description: Immutable Android application ID, for example ai.apteva.mobile.

apiKeyId.description: Optional Google API key resource UID. Omit to let Firebase associate or provision a suitable key.

tools.name: get_android_config
tools.description: Download an Android app configuration artifact. configFileContents is the complete google-services.json encoded as base64 bytes. Treat it as build configuration: decode only where needed and do not log its contents.

project_id.description: Firebase project ID or project number.

app_id.description: Opaque Firebase Android app ID returned as appId.

tools.name: get_operation
tools.description: Poll a Firebase Management long-running operation. Pass only the opaque segment after operations/ from the Operation name returned by create_android_app. When done=true, inspect error or response; operations are removed automatically after completion.

operation_id.description: Opaque operation identifier without the operations/ prefix.

tools.name: list_android_sha
tools.description: List SHA-1 and SHA-256 signing certificate hashes registered for one Firebase Android app. These certificates are not required for FCM delivery, but other Firebase products such as Google Sign-In or App Check may require them.

project_id.description: Firebase project ID or project number.

tools.name: add_android_sha
tools.description: Register one SHA-1 or SHA-256 signing certificate hash for a Firebase Android app. Do not add a duplicate returned by list_android_sha.

project_id.description: Firebase project ID or project number.

shaHash.description: Certificate fingerprint in the format expected by Firebase, normally colon-separated hexadecimal bytes.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send one Firebase Cloud Messaging HTTP v1 message through an explicit Firebase project. Set exactly one target on message: fid (preferred for current Firebase SDKs), token (legacy/deprecated), topic, or condition. The connected Google identity needs cloudmessaging.messages.create on the selected project.

project_id.description: Firebase sender project ID or project number.

message.description: FCM Message object. Supply exactly one of fid, token, topic, or condition plus data and/or notification content.

fid.description: Firebase Installation ID to target. Preferred for current Firebase SDKs.

token.description: Legacy FCM registration token. Deprecated by Firebase in favor of fid.

android.description: AndroidConfig including priority, ttl, collapse_key, restricted_package_name, data, notification, and fcm_options.

webpush.description: Web Push-specific headers, data, notification, and fcm_options.

validate_only.description: Validate the request and IAM authorization without delivering the message.
